Product Description

Woodwick® Trilogy Collection offers fragrance combinations, each creating its own, unique experience as the layers melt together! All Woodwick® Trilogy Collection Candles feature the iconic wooden lid, and are available in Large Hourglass (4.0" x 7.0"), Medium Hourglass (3.88" x 4.5") and select fragrances in Ellipse Candles (7.5" x 4.75" x 3.63").

    Important information

    Safety Information

    Keep away from flammable materials. Do not leave unattended. Trim wick to 1/4 inch before each lighting. Discontinue use when 1/2 inch of wax remains. Never leave a burning candle unattended.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Read This Review
      Reviewed in the United States on October 8, 2025
      Color: Café SweetsSize: 21.5oz

      This Review is Important to read!

      I ordered this WoodWick 'Glass' Candle (and another brand Glass Candle ) . They arrived Quickly and in the Same Box. The WoodWick was in its own FACTORY packaged box ( as was the other ). Both were Well Packaged. Neither moved around in their perspective boxes. Neither were broken!!! But there was wiggle room inside of the Amazon box.

      I speak of this candle and the other for a reason. People Claim, that their candle arrived broken. Well, this is my opinion, I dont see that happening. After opening and inspecting Both candles I repackaged them...and out of pure curiosity, I threw the box on my ceramic tile floor. I then picked it up and saw a dent in the Amazon box. I opened it and opened the individual candles boxes and inspected both. Now, you would think that there would have been at least one, broken. To my surprise, neither were broken. Do you know why? I'll tell you, it is the way that the Factory Packaged them. So, I concluded that the Factory must have Packaged them broken for the other customers.

      My point is, do Not always believe the negative reviews. Unless, Amazon and their Drivers are playing football with their deliveries ( that is on them) I dont believe that the businesses are sending you, On Purpose, broken items. They would be out of business!!! There would be No Businesses in that case. Mature Adults you know what I'm talking about.

      If i am correct, I believe that right in the add it states a 30 day $ back. And look for yourself but if the Item is damaged you can file a claim. Maybe that is only for Prime members. ??

      Back to the candle; this is a lovely candle. It is Not 40 years old, so it Does have Scent! It smells wonderful ( I smell it throught my medium size house.) Yes. The wax melts lol they do that. It melts, it liquifies... I see no soot. It smells great and has an Average burn time. The crackling sound is relaxing and reminds me of sitting around a small camp fire.

      I have used WoodWick candles for decades; In different states. Their quality has not changed. I recommend this for x-mas, birthdays, thank you, anniversaries, Thanksgiving. Or.... whatever.

      The packaging was perfect—nothing broken or torn, it arrived beautifully. The moment I opened it, I could smell the fragrance right away, and it was exactly as described. The wicks crackled just like a cozy fireplace, which was such a nice touch. Once lit, the scent filled the room almost instantly and completely covered any other odors. As for durability… well, it hasn’t fallen off my table yet, so I’ll be sure to come back with an update on that part!

      Arrivata nei tempi previsti, ben imballata perciò intatta, prezzo conveniente,il profumo che emana è straordinario e persiste anche il giorno dopo (dopo averla lasciata accesa per 10 ore circa). Non si consuma molto velocemente (paragonandolo ad altre candele), il rumore dello stoppino che brucia si sente, è piacevole e allo stesso tempo si percepisce anche il "profumo di legna bruciata", un profumo che con le candele con lo stoppino in cotone non esiste. Ne consiglio l'acquisto, soprattutto come regalo.

    About this Item

    • Cafe Sweets: The Café Sweets Trilogy was composed by our fragrance curators with the layered scents of Vanilla Bean, Caramel, and Biscotti
    • Features three complementary fragrances that create an intriguing scent experience as the layers melt together
    • The patented Pluswick Innovation wick enhances the experience with a distinctive crackling sound
    • Hourglass shaped vessel creates an increased wax pool for greater fragrancing
    • Made with a premium blend of soy and paraffin wax

    Product Description

    Woodwick® Trilogy Collection offers fragrance combinations, each creating its own, unique experience as the layers melt together! All Woodwick® Trilogy Collection Candles feature the iconic wooden lid, and are available in Large Hourglass (4.0" x 7.0"), Medium Hourglass (3.88" x 4.5") and select fragrances in Ellipse Candles (7.5" x 4.75" x 3.63").
